readings.scope: Adon Olam final line, gimel of גויתי (/tmp/blessings-micro-gviati.png)
readings.visual_evidence: There is a small dark dot inside the gimel's body, at mid-height and separate from the vertical sheva pair below the letter. The crop is low-resolution and the dot is close to the stroke, so it could be a print speck. It is not clipped.

readings.text: a mark sits inside the final kaf at mid-height; I can't tell if it is a dagesh dot or the kamatz printed inside the letter
readings.visual_evidence: There is a small dark mark inside the bowl of the final kaf. A wedge or triangle accent sits below the baseline at the kaf/sof-pasuq end. At this resolution I can't separate a round dot from the small T-shape of a kamatz printed inside a final kaf. Not clipped.

readings.scope: EluDevarim, vowel under resh of והראיון (/tmp/blessings-micro-harayon.png)
readings.text: sheva (two dots stacked vertically) under resh, not tsere
readings.visual_evidence: Under the resh are two dots stacked vertically. They are not side by side, so the mark is not a tsere. The heh has a kamatz (T-shape) with a horizontal bar next to it, which makes the vowel-letter alignment around heh/resh a bit crowded. The vav's sheva is clearly separate, at the right of the word.

The word is at the crop edge. The initial bet looks complete, and a dot appears inside its body above the sheva. The glyph is very close to the frame, though, so a small edge clip can't be ruled out. Note: the word cut off at the start of line 3 of this crop is the second בקרבי, not this one.

In the close crop the whole initial bet is visible, with a distinct dot inside its body above the vertical sheva dots below it. The wider line confirms the order כל זמן שהנשמה בקרבי מודה. Not clipped in bekirbi2.

remaining_ambiguities: Q2: the mark inside the final kaf of ויחנך could be a dagesh or the kamatz drawn inside the letter. This needs a higher-resolution crop of just that glyph.
Q1: the gimel dot in גויתי is visible but close to the stroke. A higher-resolution crop would rule out a print speck.
Q4: the first בקרבי is right at the crop edge. A crop with margin around the initial bet would confirm the dot isn't an artifact and the letter isn't partly clipped.
